total_supply_after_constructor.meaning: totalSupply value pre-set by the HypoVault constructor

underlying_assets_after_constructor.meaning: underlying assets owned by the vault after the constructor

total_assets_before_first_fulfillment.meaning: totalAssets (computeNAV() == assetsDeposited) observed before the first fulfilment

shares_received_first_deposit.meaning: sharesReceived minted to the depositor for the very first deposit

assets_to_fulfill_first_deposit.meaning: assetsToFulfill supplied for the very first deposit

fee_nav_integrations_wrong_occurred.meaning: performance-fee logic, NAV reporting and share-price-dependent integrations are wrong

unresolved.description: The selected impact is a qualitative statement that fee logic, NAV reporting and share-price integrations are wrong; the report gives no numeric observable relating the first-deposit mint to those downstream computations, so the impact is encoded as a grounded Boolean occurrence.

limitations: The intent relation (sharesReceived == assetsToFulfill for the first deposit) is encoded as the desired relation; the impact is a separate qualitative Boolean witness and is not derived from the intent relation.
The report does not state the exact share-mint formula operands beyond the 1-wei denominator and the 1 000-asset / 1 000 000 000-share example; the mint relation is kept symbolic.
The checkpoint of totalAssets == 1 relative to constructor versus first fulfillment is taken as before the first fulfillment per the source text.
